Subject: Kickoff: Merchant banking & tax intake for Orchard Studio

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing the MSA. To get Orchard set up in our procurement system and to issue POs, our finance team needs a few items from you. I’ve listed a short intake checklist below so we can move to a first PO and set up ACH payments: 

- Legal entity name, registered address, and DBA (if any)
- Tax ID/EIN (or VAT number if non-US)
- Remit-to address (if different)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number) OR wire instructions (SWIFT/BIC, IBAN where applicable)
- Completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for non-US)
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable)

If you can send the bank letter (on bank letterhead) and your W-9 by early next week, Marcus in finance will be able to approve vendor creation and we can issue an initial PO. I’m copying Marcus here for any follow-ups on formatting or verification.

Also: Do you prefer POs sent to procurement@orchardstudio.co or a specific project mailbox?

Thanks —

Monica Patel
